general.description: Orbiting around the same gas giant as the jump point itself, this Border Station was originally a mere refuelling outpost for exploration beyond the Lalerin system. When the route to the Instrumentality Company was discovered, it was hastily extended to become both a trading station and a military base.
general.bar: Sshaads from all the species' States, some Shapeshifters and a few non-Complementarists, mainly Humans and Pupeteers
